summary: Flat school-street kerb where cars park, but homes 12-14 m on this side.

best_section.where: North kerb of Ironside Street opposite the school buildings and kindergarten

drivers.seclusion: School and kindergarten buildings face the south kerb; detached homes sit 12-14 m back on the north side under trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane; several cars parked along the kerb, room for a van in line.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, busy only at school drop-off times.
drivers.convention: Signed 1/4P only at 7:30-9:15am and 2-4pm on schooldays; cars park here, so a van blends in overnight.

flags: Homes 12-14 m away on the same side
Short-stay school-hours sign applies in the morning
sun_shade: Large street trees shade the kerb, mainly from the north and east.
cannot_judge: Whether the school-hours limit is enforced
